name: Manifold Vertex Clustering
definition: An extension of adaptive contouring that requires collapsible vertices to satisfy an additional topology criterion to ensure the simplified contour is a 2-manifold (every edge shared by two polygons, every vertex surrounded by a disk-like neighborhood).
summary: Manifold Vertex Clustering is a topological constraint for adaptive isosurface extraction that ensures the resulting mesh is a closed 2-manifold by checking the Euler characteristic and edge intersections, unlike standard methods relying solely on geometric error.
